conventions.entities: findings are keyed by the check's own entity: FUND-ROUNDTRIP, FUND-THIRD-PARTY and FUND-FREQUENT name the unitholder (unitholder_id); FUND-SHARED-ACCT the account (bank_account value); FUND-CHURN the agent; FUND-LATE-TRADE the order id (the finding row of F-R6 is keyed by the unitholder U-0606 in findings, the order is O-6006). entity_type labels: unitholder / fund / account / agent
conventions.period: the period is the month of the record that completes the pattern: the sale (F-R1, F-R2), the transactions of the month (F-R4, F-R5), the order (F-R6); for a pattern over several records the latest month of the contributing records (BA-7000 2026-09)
conventions.counterparty: bank_account holds the ACCOUNT OWNER: the unitholder id (U-nnnn, the unitholder_id format) of the owner of the account paid or receiving, so FUND-THIRD-PARTY can compare it with the unitholder. BA-5555 of the design belongs to U-0999: it is written as its owner U-0999 on the redemption of U-0202 (F-R2 reports U-0202). The shared account of F-R3 is written as its number BA-7000 (owner not known): F-R3 reports it, F-R2 cannot compare that format and must not report the four holders
conventions.F-R4: U-0404 makes 10 transactions in 2026-07 (4 BUY, 3 SWO, 3 SWI in 7 funds, no SELL); the six clients of AG-05 (U-0501..U-0506) make 8 each in 2026-08 (4 BUY, 2 SWO, 2 SWI); they are F-R4 findings too, because FUND-FREQUENT reports every holder with 6+ transactions in a month. Normal holders make 1 or 2 a month
conventions.F-R5: AG-05 has 15 clients, 6 of them (40 %) hit F-R4; AG-06 (U-0404's agent) has 1 frequent client of 12 and is not reported
conventions.F-R1: U-0101 buys FX1 2026-05-06 and sells it 2026-05-15 (9 days, 98 % of the purchase). Near misses that must not be reported: 8 holders sell the same fund 55+ days later at 90-110 %, 4 holders sell within 10-25 days at 40-55 %. Switches are never sales
conventions.F-R6: O-6006 (U-0606) was ordered 2026-09-16 16:10 with NAV date 2026-09-16 (after the 15:30 cut-off and priced the same day). Five normal orders after the cut-off (15:40-16:20) are priced on the next business day and must not be reported. In variants/date_only the time of day is missing: F-R6 cannot be judged

data_request: วันที่ของคำสั่งซื้อขายที่มีเวลา (ชั่วโมง:นาที) เพื่อดูคำสั่งที่ทำหลังเวลาตัดรอบ
date_only.note: variants/date_only/fund_txn.csv has order_datetime as a date only; every other table and the roles are the en variant. FUND-LATE-TRADE is Skipped with a reason and F-R6 is 🟡 (บางส่วน) with this Data Request, as the spec says

conventions.normal: every other holder: one fund and one fixed amount, 1-2 transactions a month for 10 months, weekdays day 5-24, 09:00-15:00, NAV date = order date, counterparty = the holder; amounts 3,000-9,999 and never round, so the general cards (STAT-MAD per agent, BEH-VELOCITY, BEH-SPIKE, TEMP-OFFHOURS, GEN-CONC, GEN-PERIOD-END, FOR-*) find nothing
conventions.code_values: fund_txn.txn_type: BUY buy, SELL sell, SWI switch_in, SWO switch_out
conventions.intake: sufficiency: F-R1, F-R2 and F-R6 are พร้อม (the unitholders join the transactions on 100 % of the holders, the time of day and the NAV date are present, so F-R6 runs); the letter has no concern without data, so data_request is empty; suggested_risks are the risks with a planted case that the letter did not ask for: F-R3, F-R4, F-R5; the brief and the data have no description conflict
conventions.legacy_dataset_type: variants/roles_legacy.json carries a top-level "dataset_type": "F" next to the {table: {column: role}} mapping; pass it as confirm answers["dataset_type"] and drop it from the roles mapping before to_internal
